sanskrit: etac chrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ pitāmahasamīritam aṅkenādāya vaidehīm utpapāta vibhāvasuḥ
english: Having heard this auspicious speech uttered by the Grandfather (Brahmā), Vibhāvasu (Agni, the fire-god) leapt forth, taking Vaidehī in his arms.

sanskrit: taruṇādityasaṃkāśāṃ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇām raktāmbaradharāṃ bālāṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām
english: She resembled the rising sun; she was adorned with ornaments of refined gold; she wore red garments; she was young, with dark and curling hair—

sanskrit: akliṣṭamālyābharaṇāṃ tathā rūpāṃ manasvinīm dadau rāmāya vaidehīm aṅke kṛtvā vibhāvasuḥ
english: —bearing unfaded garlands and ornaments, lovely in form, and noble of spirit: Vibhāvasu, placing Vaidehī upon his lap, presented her to Rāma.

sanskrit: abravīc ca tadā rāmaṃ sākṣī lokasya pāvakaḥ eṣā te rāma vaidehī pāpam asyā na vidyate
english: And then Pāvaka (Agni), the witness of all the worlds, spoke to Rāma: "Here is your Vaidehī, O Rāma; no sin exists in her.

sanskrit: naiva vācā na manasā nānudhyānān na cakṣuṣā suvṛttā vṛttaśauṇḍīrā na tvām aticacāra ha
english: Neither by speech, nor by mind, nor by contemplation, nor by glance has this virtuous woman, proud of her good conduct, ever transgressed against you.

sanskrit: rāvaṇenāpanītaiṣā vīryotsiktena rakṣasā tvayā virahitā dīnā vivaśā nirjanād vanāt
english: She was carried off by Rāvaṇa, that demon swollen with arrogance; separated from you, she was wretched and helpless, taken from the desolate forest.

sanskrit: ruddhā cāntaḥpure guptā tvakcittā tvatparāyaṇā rakṣitā rākṣasī saṃghair vikṛtair ghoradarśanaiḥ
english: Imprisoned within the inner chambers, guarded closely, her mind fixed on you alone, wholly devoted to you, she was watched over by bands of deformed and dreadful-looking rākṣasīs.

sanskrit: pralobhyamānā vividhaṃ bhartsyamānā ca maithilī nācintayata tad rakṣas tvadgatenāntarātmanā
english: Though tempted in various ways and repeatedly threatened, Maithilī gave no thought to that demon, for her innermost soul was wholly given over to you.

sanskrit: viśuddhabhāvāṃ niṣpāpāṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva rāghava na kiṃ cid abhidhātavyam aham ājñāpayāmi te
english: Take back this woman of pure heart and free of sin, O Rāghava. There is nothing to be said against her — I command you thus.

sanskrit: evam ukto mahātejā dhṛtimān dṛḍhavikramaḥ abravīt tridaśaśreṣṭhaṃ rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
english: Thus addressed, Rāma — of great splendour, firm resolve, and steadfast valour, the foremost among upholders of dharma — spoke to that chief of the thirty gods (Agni):

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sītā pāvanam arhati dīrghakāloṣitā ceyaṃ rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhā
english: "Sītā must certainly undergo purification before the three worlds, for this auspicious woman has long dwelt in Rāvaṇa's inner chambers.

sanskrit: bāliśaḥ khalu kāmātmā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ iti vakṣyanti māṃ santo jānakīm aviśodhya hi
english: For the virtuous would say of me, 'Rāma, son of Daśaratha, is foolish and enslaved by desire,' if I were to take back Jānakī without purifying her.

sanskrit: ananyahṛdayāṃ bhaktāṃ maccittaparirakṣaṇīm aham apy avagacchāmi maithilīṃ janakātmajām
english: I too know Maithilī, daughter of Janaka, to be undivided in her heart, devoted, and scrupulously guarded in her mind toward me.

sanskrit: pratyayārthaṃ tu lokānāṃ trayāṇāṃ satyasaṃśrayaḥ upekṣe cāpi vaidehīṃ praviśantīṃ hutāśanam
english: But for the conviction of the three worlds — I who am anchored in truth — I allowed Vaidehī to enter the sacrificial fire.

sanskrit: imām api viśālākṣīṃ rakṣitāṃ svena tejasā rāvaṇo nātivarteta velām iva mahodadhiḥ
english: Even this wide-eyed woman, protected by her own radiance, could not be transgressed by Rāvaṇa, just as the great ocean cannot overstep its shore.

sanskrit: na hi śaktaḥ sa duṣṭātmā manasāpi hi maithilīm pradharṣayitum aprāptāṃ dīptām agniśikhām iva
english: That evil-souled one was not capable of violating Maithilī even in thought — she who was beyond his reach, blazing like a tongue of fire.

sanskrit: neyam arhati caiśvaryaṃ rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhā ananyā hi mayā sītāṃ bhāskareṇa prabhā yathā
english: This auspicious woman does not deserve the taint of Rāvaṇa's dominion over her, for Sītā is inseparable from me as radiance is from the sun.

sanskrit: viśuddhā triṣu lokeṣu maithilī janakātmajā na hi hātum iyaṃ śakyā kīrtir ātmavatā yathā
english: Maithilī, daughter of Janaka, is pure in all three worlds; she is no more to be abandoned than a self-possessed man can abandon his own fame.

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ ca mayā kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ vo vaco hitam snigdhānāṃ lokamānyānām evaṃ ca bruvatāṃ hitam
english: And I must comply with the salutary word of all of you — affectionate, honoured in all the worlds, and speaking thus for my welfare."

sanskrit: itīdam uktvā vacanaṃ mahābalaiḥ praśasyamānaḥ svakṛtena karmaṇā sametya rāmaḥ priyayā mahābalaḥ sukhaṃ sukhārho 'nubabhūva rāghavaḥ
english: Having spoken these words and being praised by the mighty gods for his own deeds, Rāma the mighty — Rāghava who was worthy of happiness — was reunited with his beloved and experienced joy.

sanskrit: etac chrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ rāghaveṇa subhāṣitam idaṃ śubhataraṃ vākyaṃ vyājahāra maheśvaraḥ
english: Having heard this auspicious speech spoken eloquently by Rāghava, Maheśvara (Śiva) uttered these still more auspicious words:

sanskrit: puṣkarākṣa mahābāho mahāvakṣaḥ paraṃtapa diṣṭyā kṛtam idaṃ karma tvayā śastrabhṛtāṃ vara
english: "O lotus-eyed one, mighty-armed one, broad-chested one, scorcher of foes — by good fortune this deed has been accomplished by you, O foremost among those who bear arms!

sanskrit: diṣṭyā sarvasya lokasya pravṛddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ tamaḥ apāvṛttaṃ tvayā saṃkhye rāma rāvaṇajaṃ bhayam
english: By good fortune, O Rāma, the dreadful darkness that had spread over all the worlds, the terror born of Rāvaṇa, has been rolled back by you in battle.

sanskrit: āśvāsya bharataṃ dīnaṃ kausalyāṃ ca yaśasvinīm kaikeyīṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamātaram
english: Console Bharata who is afflicted with grief; and visit the glorious Kausalyā, and Kaikeyī, and Sumitrā — the mother of Lakṣmaṇa;

sanskrit: prāpya rājyam ayodhyāyāṃ nandayitvā suhṛjjanam ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule vaṃśaṃ sthāpayitvā mahābala
english: regain the kingdom of Ayodhyā, delight your well-wishers, and establish the lineage in the family of the Ikṣvākus, O mighty one;

sanskrit: iṣṭvā turagamedhena prāpya cānuttamaṃ yaśaḥ brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā tridivaṃ gantum arhasi
english: having performed the horse-sacrifice and attained incomparable glory, having given wealth to the brāhmaṇas — then you shall be worthy to go to the heavenly realm."

sanskrit: eṣa rājā vimānasthaḥ pitā daśarathas tava kākutstha mānuṣe loke gurus tava mahāyaśāḥ
english: "O Kākutstha, there stands your father, King Daśaratha, seated in his celestial vehicle — your revered elder in the human world, of great and illustrious fame.

sanskrit: indralokaṃ gataḥ śrīmāṃs tvayā putreṇa tāritaḥ lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā tvam enam abhivādaya
english: The glorious one has reached Indra's realm, ferried across by you, his son. Pay your respects to him together with your brother Lakṣmaṇa."

sanskrit: mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ vimānaśikharasthasya praṇāmam akarot pituḥ
english: Hearing the words of Mahādeva (Śiva), Kākutstha together with Lakṣmaṇa bowed in reverence to his father who stood at the summit of the celestial vehicle.

sanskrit: dīpyamānaṃ svayāṃ lakṣmyā virajo'mbaradhāriṇam lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dadarśa pitaraṃ prabhuḥ
english: The lord saw his father blazing with his own radiance, clothed in spotless garments, together with his brother Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo vimānastho mahīpatiḥ prāṇaiḥ priyataraṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ daśarathas tadā
english: Then Daśaratha, that ruler of the earth, seated in the celestial vehicle, was seized with great joy upon beholding his son who was dearer to him than life.

sanskrit: āropyāṅkaṃ mahābāhur varāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ bāhubhyāṃ saṃpariṣvajya tato vākyaṃ samādade
english: The mighty-armed lord, seated on a splendid throne, lifted him onto his lap, embraced him with both arms, and then began to speak:

sanskrit: na me svargo bahumataḥ saṃmānaś ca surarṣibhiḥ tvayā rāma vihīnasya satyaṃ pratiśṛṇomi te
english: "Heaven is not dear to me, nor the honour shown by gods and sages, when I am deprived of you, O Rāma — this I promise you in truth.

sanskrit: kaikeyyā yāni coktāni vākyāni vadatāṃ vara tava pravrājanārthāni sthitāni hṛdaye mama
english: The words spoken by Kaikeyī, O foremost of speakers, those words aimed at sending you into exile — they have weighed upon my heart.

sanskrit: tvāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā kuśalinaṃ pariṣvajya salakṣmaṇam adya duḥkhād vimukto 'smi nīhārād iva bhāskaraḥ
english: But now, seeing you well and embracing you together with Lakṣmaṇa, I am this day freed from sorrow, as the sun is freed from mist.

sanskrit: tārito 'haṃ tvayā putra suputreṇa mahātmanā aṣṭāvakreṇa dharmātmā tārito brāhmaṇo yathā
english: I have been ferried across by you, O son, by a noble son of great soul — as the righteous brahmin was once ferried across by Aṣṭāvakra.

sanskrit: idānīṃ ca vijānāmi yathā saumya sureśvaraiḥ vadhārthaṃ rāvaṇasyeha vihitaṃ puruṣottamam
english: And now I understand, O gentle one, how the highest among men was appointed here by the lords of the gods for the purpose of slaying Rāvaṇa.

sanskrit: siddhārthā khalu kausalyā yā tvāṃ rāma gṛhaṃ gatam vanān nivṛttaṃ saṃhṛṣṭā drakṣyate śatrusūdana
english: Truly, Kausalyā has achieved her purpose — she who, filled with joy, will behold you, O slayer of enemies, returned from the forest and come home.

sanskrit: siddhārthāḥ khalu te rāma narā ye tvāṃ purīṃ gatam jalārdram abhiṣiktaṃ ca drakṣyanti vasudhādhipam
english: Truly, those men have achieved their purpose, O Rāma, who will behold you as lord of the earth, entered into the city and anointed with consecration-waters.

sanskrit: anuraktena balinā śucinā dharmacāriṇā iccheyaṃ tvām ahaṃ draṣṭuṃ bharatena samāgatam
english: I wish to see you united with Bharata, who is devoted to you, mighty, pure, and devoted to dharma.

sanskrit: caturdaśasamāḥ saumya vane niryāpitās tvayā vasatā sītayā sārdhaṃ lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā
english: Fourteen years, O gentle one, have been spent by you dwelling in the forest together with Sītā and the wise Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: nivṛttavanavāso 'si pratijñā saphalā kṛtā rāvaṇaṃ ca raṇe hatvā devās te paritoṣitāḥ
english: Your forest-exile is ended, your vow has been fulfilled; having slain Rāvaṇa in battle, you have given satisfaction to the gods.

sanskrit: kṛtaṃ karma yaśaḥ ślāghyaṃ prāptaṃ te śatrusūdana bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājyastho dīrgham āyur avāpnuhi
english: A praiseworthy deed has been accomplished and glorious renown has been attained by you, O slayer of enemies. Established in the kingdom together with your brothers, may you enjoy a long life."

sanskrit: iti bruvāṇaṃ rājānaṃ rāmaḥ prāñjalir abravīt kuru prasādaṃ dharmajña kaikeyyā bharatasya ca
english: To the king speaking thus, Rāma spoke with folded hands: "O knower of dharma, grant your grace to Kaikeyī and to Bharata.

sanskrit: saputrāṃ tvāṃ tyajāmīti yad uktā kaikayī tvayā sa śāpaḥ kaikayīṃ ghoraḥ saputrāṃ na spṛśet prabho
english: The dreadful curse you pronounced upon Kaikeyī — 'I abandon you together with your son' — let that curse, O lord, not touch Kaikeyī together with her son."

sanskrit: sa tatheti mahārājo rāmam uktvā kṛtāñjaliḥ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca pariṣvajya punar vākyam uvāca ha
english: The great king said "So be it" to Rāma who stood with joined palms; then, embracing Lakṣmaṇa, he spoke again:

sanskrit: rāmaṃ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā kṛtā mama mahāprītiḥ prāptaṃ dharmaphalaṃ ca te
english: "By serving Rāma with devotion, together with Vaidehī Sītā, you have given me great joy, and you have obtained the fruit of dharma.

sanskrit: dharmaṃ prāpsyasi dharmajña yaśaś ca vipulaṃ bhuvi rāme prasanne svargaṃ ca mahimānaṃ tathaiva ca
english: You shall attain dharma, O knower of dharma, and abundant glory on earth; and, with Rāma pleased with you, you shall also attain heaven and greatness.

sanskrit: rāmaṃ śuśrūṣa bhadraṃ te sumitrānandavardhana rāmaḥ sarvasya lokasya śubheṣv abhirataḥ sadā
english: Serve Rāma — be blessed, O increaser of Sumitrā's joy! Rāma is always devoted to the welfare of all the worlds.

sanskrit: ete sendrās trayo lokāḥ siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ abhigamya mahātmānam arcanti puruṣottamam
english: These three worlds together with Indra, the Siddhas, and the supreme sages, approach and worship this great-souled one, Puruṣottama (the highest of beings).

sanskrit: etat tad uktam avyaktam akṣaraṃ brahmanirmitam devānāṃ hṛdayaṃ saumya guhyaṃ rāmaḥ paraṃtapaḥ
english: This is he of whom it is spoken as the unmanifest, the imperishable, the one fashioned by Brahman, the heart of the gods, O gentle one, the secret — Rāma, the scorcher of foes.

sanskrit: avāptaṃ dharmacaraṇaṃ yaśaś ca vipulaṃ tvayā rāmaṃ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā
english: By serving Rāma with devotion together with Vaidehī Sītā, you have obtained the practice of dharma and abundant glory.

sanskrit: sa tathoktvā mahābāhur lakṣmaṇaṃ prāñjaliṃ sthitam uvāca rājā dharmātmā vaidehīṃ vacanaṃ śubham
english: Having spoken thus to Lakṣmaṇa who stood with joined palms, that righteous king of mighty arms then spoke these auspicious words to Vaidehī:

sanskrit: kartavyo na tu vaidehi manyus tyāgam imaṃ prati rāmeṇa tvadviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtam etad dhitaiṣiṇā
english: "Do not feel anger regarding this abandonment, O Vaidehī; this was done by Rāma, who seeks your good, for the purpose of establishing your purity.

sanskrit: na tvaṃ subhru samādheyā patiśuśrūvaṇaṃ prati avaśyaṃ tu mayā vācyam eṣa te daivataṃ param
english: You, O fair-browed one, need no instruction regarding devotion to your husband; yet it must be said by me: he is your supreme deity.

sanskrit: iti pratisamādiśya putrau sītāṃ tathā snuṣām indralokaṃ vimānena yayau daśaratho jvalan
english: Having thus instructed both sons, Sītā, and his daughter-in-law, the blazing Daśaratha departed to Indra's realm in his celestial vehicle.

sanskrit: pratiprayāte kākutsthe mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ abravīt paramaprīto rāghavaṃ prāñjaliṃ sthitam
english: After Kākutstha (Daśaratha) had departed, Mahendra — the chastiser of Pāka — filled with the highest delight, spoke to Rāghava who stood with joined palms:

sanskrit: amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma tavāsmākaṃ paraṃtapa prītiyukto 'smi tena tvaṃ brūhi yan manasecchasi
english: "Your sight to us, O Rāma, O scorcher of foes, is never in vain. I am filled with affection on that account — speak, tell me whatever your mind desires."

sanskrit: evam uktas tu kākutsthaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā cāpi bhāryayā
english: Thus addressed, Kākutstha — together with his brother Lakṣmaṇa and his wife Sītā — replied with joined palms:

sanskrit: yadi prītiḥ samutpannā mayi sarvasureśvara vakṣyāmi kuru me satyaṃ vacanaṃ vadatāṃ vara
english: "If affection has arisen for me, O lord of all the gods, then I shall speak — fulfil my word truly, O foremost of speakers.

sanskrit: mama hetoḥ parākrāntā ye gatā yamasādanam te sarve jīvitaṃ prāpya samuttiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ
english: All those vānaras who fought valiantly on my behalf and went to the abode of Yama — let them all rise again, having obtained life.

sanskrit: matpriyeṣv abhiraktāś ca na mṛtyuṃ gaṇayanti ca tvatprasādāt sameyus te varam etad ahaṃ vṛṇe
english: They are devoted to my beloved ones and did not reckon with death; by your grace, let them be reunited with their kin. This is the boon I choose.

sanskrit: nīrujān nirvraṇāṃś caiva saṃpannabalapauruṣān golāṅgūlāṃs tathaivarkṣān draṣṭum icchāmi mānada
english: I wish to see them — the golāṅgūlas (tailed monkeys) and likewise the ṛkṣas (bears) — free of disease, free of wounds, fully endowed with strength and vigour, O granter of honour.

sanskrit: akāle cāpi mukhyāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca nadyaś ca vimalās tatra tiṣṭheyur yatra vānarāḥ
english: And even out of season, let choice roots and fruits be available, and let clear rivers stand wherever the vānaras may be."

sanskrit: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ mahendraḥ pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ prītilakṣaṇam
english: Having heard those words of that great-souled Rāghava, Mahendra replied with words marked by affection:

sanskrit: mahān ayaṃ varas tāta tvayokto raghunandana samutthāsyanti harayaḥ suptā nidrākṣaye yathā
english: "Great is this boon you have named, O dear one, O joy of the Raghus: the monkeys shall rise again, as those who slept wake at the passing of slumber.

sanskrit: suhṛdbhir bāndhavaiś caiva jñātibhiḥ svajanena ca sarva eva sameṣyanti saṃyuktāḥ parayā mudā
english: They shall all be reunited with their friends, kinsmen, relatives, and own people, joined together with the highest joy.

sanskrit: akāle puṣpaśabalāḥ phalavantaś ca pādapāḥ bhaviṣyanti maheṣvāsa nadyaś ca salilāyutāḥ
english: Even out of season, the trees shall be filled with blossoms and laden with fruit, O great archer, and the rivers shall be full of water."

sanskrit: savraṇaiḥ prathamaṃ gātraiḥ saṃvṛtair nivraṇaiḥ punaḥ babhūvur vānarāḥ sarve kim etad iti vismitaḥ
english: The vānaras whose limbs had first been covered with wounds became again free of wounds; all of them arose, astonished and asking, "What is this?"

sanskrit: kākutsthaṃ paripūrṇārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve surottamāḥ ūcus te prathamaṃ stutvā stavārhaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam
english: All the foremost gods, seeing Kākutstha whose purpose was fully accomplished, first praised him who was worthy of praise together with Lakṣmaṇa, and then spoke:

sanskrit: gacchāyodhyām ito vīra visarjaya ca vānarān maithilīṃ sāntvayasvainām anuraktāṃ tapasvinīm
english: "Go hence to Ayodhyā, O hero; dismiss the vānaras; and comfort Maithilī, this devoted and long-suffering woman.

sanskrit: bhrātaraṃ paśya bharataṃ tvacchokād vratacāriṇam abhiṣecaya cātmānaṃ paurān gatvā praharṣaya
english: See your brother Bharata who has been observing vows in his grief for you; anoint yourself as king, and going to the citizens, bring them joy."

sanskrit: evam uktvā tam āmantrya rāmaṃ saumitriṇā saha vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśair hṛṣṭā jagmuḥ surā divam
english: Having spoken thus and taking leave of Rāma together with the son of Sumitrā, the gods, filled with joy, departed to heaven in celestial vehicles blazing like the sun.

sanskrit: abhivādya ca kākutsthaḥ sarvāṃs tāṃs tridaśottamān lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vāsam ājñāpayat tadā
english: And Kākutstha, having paid his respects to all those foremost of the thirty gods, then commanded his army to encamp, together with his brother Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: tatas tu sā lakṣmaṇarāmapālitā mahācamūr hṛṣṭajanā yaśasvinī śriyā jvalantī virarāja sarvato niśāpraṇīteva hi śītaraśminā
english: Then that great army, guarded by Lakṣmaṇa and Rāma, its people filled with joy, glorious and blazing with splendour, shone resplendently on every side — even as the moon, led forth by night, blazes with cool radiance.
